cohort: 339 children aged 0-23 months in field practice areas of Rural & Urban Health Training Centres (RHTC & UHTC), Department of Community Medicine, Govt. Medical College, Haldwani, District Nainital
finding: The prevalence of early initiation of breastfeeding was 45.1% and was significantly associated with place of delivery, mode of delivery, mother's education, and ANC care.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with early initiation of breastfeeding.
